name: OSS_SUB_BATCHES
description: This table is used to capture information on the sub batches run for the async action ess job.

columns.name: SUB_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Indicates the sub batch identifier for the table.

columns.name: FLOW_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Identifies the flow sequence of a given flow type.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifies the batch identifier from the OSS_BATCHES table.

columns.name: BATCH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SUB_BATCH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifies the request id for the sub batch.

columns.name: SUB_BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Identifies the status of the sub batch. Can have values 0 (New), 1 (Success) and 2 (Error).

columns.name: JOB_ITEM_COUNT
columns.description: Identifies the number of items being processed in the batch.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Identifies the start date of the sub batch.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Identifies the end date of the sub batch.

columns.name: ACTION
columns.description: Identifies the action being executed for this sub batch.

columns.name: PHASE
columns.description: Identifies the phase of the sub batch job.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
